title: Warm French Gochugaru Cassoulet
description: A post-workout French dish that combines the resinous flavor of gochugaru with the tanginess of ferment-kimchi in a Mediterranean-friendly cassoulet.

ingredients.name: Goat meat
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of shoulder and shank for tender results.

ingredients.name: Ferment-kimchi
ingredients.notes: Make sure to squeeze out excess liquid before adding.

ingredients.name: Gochugaru
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste, but be cautious of spiciness.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.notes: Fresh herb adds a bright flavor.

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Look for a high-quality, low-sodium option.

ingredients.name: Chicken broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium to control salt levels.

ingredients.name: White wine (optional)
ingredients.notes: Add for added depth, but reduce liquid accordingly.

instructions: Brown goat meat in olive oil over medium-high heat, then set aside.
Soak cannellini beans overnight, then simmer in chicken broth until tender.
Mince garlic and cook in olive oil until fragrant.
Add thyme and bay leaves to oil, cooking for an additional minute.
Combine cooked goat meat, garlic mixture, and tomato paste in a large bowl.
Add ferment-kimchi, gochugaru, and cannellini beans to the bowl, mixing well.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
